title: LangSmith (LangChain) API key (personal access token or service key): one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: First segment shortened from 32 to 31 hex characters; every other byte and the context are unchanged and Tail segment shortened from 10 to 9 hex characters; every other byte and the context are unchanged. Twin of "LangSmith (LangChain) API key (personal access token or service key): must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of langsmith-api-key-pat-dotenv: First segment shortened from 32 to 31 hex characters; every other byte and the context are unchanged. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
